decisions.reason: Having survived the initial post-launch review and fitting very closely with the firm's core cheese capabilities, it likely performs at or near aspiration levels and is therefore kept unless portfolio simplification becomes necessary.

As a core-adjacent cheese line with several variants, it suggests enough acceptance and organisational commitment that management is more likely to retain it than reallocate resources through problemistic search.

This soft-cheese extension is somewhat more vulnerable because it appears to round out the range rather than define it, but its close resource fit and survival beyond launch still make retention more likely than withdrawal.
